# Randall Brezina

Randall Brezina is a Computer Information Technology graduate from Lethbridge
Polytechnic, based in Lethbridge, Alberta. His work includes custom PC builds,
software projects, and interface design. He is currently employed and available
for PC builds and contract work.

## Projects

- Client gaming PC: Randall selected parts, assembled the PC, installed Windows,
  and configured XMP/EXPO. The client set a $2,500 CAD budget; the completed build
  came to around $2,200 CAD. Ryzen 5 7600X3D and Radeon RX 9070 XT.
- Gaming and video editing PC: parts selection and help with assembly, planned
  for 1440p gaming, video editing, and content creation. Ryzen 5 7600 and Radeon
  RX 9070 XT, with a clean Windows 11 installation.
- My desktop PC: built for gaming, content creation, software development, and
  hardware testing. Ryzen 5 7600 and Radeon RX 6700 XT.
- My mechanical keyboard: assembled with an FL Esports MK870 case, Everglide
  Aquaking V3 55g linear switches, and Cherry Blossom PBT keycaps.
- ShelfCast: a sales dashboard built for a local business in Lethbridge using
  React, Node.js, and SQLite. Imports CSV sales exports and displays sales charts,
  category trends, per-item forecasts, and date/category filters.
- ShiftClocker: an Android shift logging app built during a practicum using
  React Native and Expo SDK 54. Supports timers, manual entries, per-job pay
  tracking, filtering, CSV/PDF reports, and ten themes.
- Brezina Strength Academy: a coaching website designed in Figma and built in
  Wix. The project focused on mobile use and accessibility and included a live
  usability test using Steve Krug's usability principles.

## PC services

- Custom PC build: $200 CAD flat fee. Includes assembly, internal cable
  management, Windows installation, and basic testing. Parts and Windows
  licensing are separate. Optional BIOS and Windows performance setup: $20 CAD.
- On-site PC build: $40 CAD/hr with a 3-hour minimum, plus $40 CAD travel.
- PC buying advice: $25 CAD per request, for prebuilt PCs, laptops, monitors,
  or a full setup.
- If Randall purchases the parts, a 3% service fee applies and he handles returns.
  If the client purchases parts, the client handles returns.
- Typical build time: 2 to 5 days after all parts arrive.
- Pickup and delivery in Lethbridge are free. Delivery outside Lethbridge
  is available for an additional fee.
- Initial quotes are estimates. Final pricing is confirmed before parts are
  purchased. See the PC services page for the current service terms.
